# Sai Dutta Abhishek Dash - Full Profile

> Founder and engineer building AI infrastructure, language technology for underserved markets, and security systems at production scale. Based in Odisha, India. Ships open source by default.

**Last updated:** November 2026

## Identity

Sai Dutta Abhishek Dash (also known as SDAD, instax-dutta, R4C3R0P, RACER IS OP, AbhishekDash69) is a founder and engineer from Odisha, India. He builds across the full stack, from Python benchmark infrastructure and Java products to Next.js web platforms, with a focus on AI infrastructure, language technology for underserved markets, and privacy-first security systems.

He has shipped 22 production systems, maintains 225+ public repositories across GitHub and Hugging Face, including 130+ models and datasets. He is AWS Certified (Cloud Practitioner, 2024) and holds a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from GIET University Gunupur (2025).

## Core Thesis

Three conviction-driven bets:

1. **Language AI should exist for every language with 10M+ speakers.** There are 38 million Odia speakers. Maelis Research is building language AI infrastructure for Odia, including tokenizer optimization, speech recognition, and translation.

2. **Measured AI infrastructure beats benchmark theater.** sysone-bench and T4-Bench preserve protocols, raw results, and reproducibility artifacts. finetune-llm turns controlled GPU measurements into a verification-gated agent workflow.

3. **Privacy and safety must be built into the system.** Binify encrypts before transmission, PhishTrap validates data before publication, gmail-automator enforces quota ceilings, and truemotion gives agents rendered-frame feedback before export.

## Detailed Product Profiles

### PhishScout
**Category:** Security Data Engineering
**Language:** Python
**Repository:** https://github.com/instax-dutta/PhishScout
**Dataset:** https://huggingface.co/datasets/saidutta69/PhishTrap
**Pipeline:** https://github.com/instax-dutta/PhishTrap

On-device phishing detector paired with PhishTrap, an original auto-refreshing phishing URL phishing dataset pipeline. PhishTrap fetches OpenPhish, Phishing.Database, PhishStats, and Tranco every six hours, canonicalizes URLs, tracks freshness, prunes expired entries, creates deterministic stratified splits, and validates before publication. PhishScout is designed for router, browser-extension, and edge-device deployment.

### MarkItDownJS
**Category:** Document Processing
**Language:** TypeScript
**URL:** https://github.com/instax-dutta/MarkItDownJS

AST-first document ingestion and conversion platform. Converts PDFs, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, CSV, JSON, XML, images, audio, EPUB, and archives into clean, LLM-friendly Markdown. Built as a Turborepo monorepo with Vite, pnpm, and RAG-ready chunking.

### sysone-bench
**Category:** AI Benchmarking
**Language:** Python
**URL:** https://sysone.sdad.pro
**Repository:** https://github.com/instax-dutta/sysone-bench

Independent byte-identical model benchmark for System One decision models. Runs 50 distinct measurements against a sealed manifest with checksummed artifacts and seed 42. The closed Jev reference scores 0.9065 while the best open model scores 0.8702 under the same protocol. Includes 36 test files, CI, public results, and reproducibility tooling.

### T4-Bench
**Category:** AI Benchmarking
**Language:** Python
**URL:** https://t4b.sdad.pro
**Repository:** https://github.com/instax-dutta/T4-Bench

Tesla T4 LLM benchmark suite for inference, fine-tuning, image, video, and agent workloads on two consumer Kaggle Tesla T4 GPUs. Preserves CSV and JSON results, reports, logs, runner scripts, and generated media. Recorded results include LFM2.5-8B-A1B at 119 tokens per second, FLUX.2 klein at 374 images per hour, and an Unsloth NF4 run at 7.1 GB versus 14.9 GB stock.

### Gupshup
**Category:** Language Dataset
**URL:** https://huggingface.co/datasets/saidutta69/Gupshup

Gupshup Hinglish corpus of privacy-scrubbed Roman-script chat, including community emote tokens. Contains 353,843 messages split into 318,458 training and 35,385 test rows. Uses author hashing, mention/link redaction, abuse filtering, documented anonymisation, and deterministic splits.

### Vulscany
**Category:** Security Engineering
**Language:** TypeScript / Next.js
**URL:** https://github.com/instax-dutta/vulscany

Private, self-hostable AI-powered code security agent. Multi-language scanning, AI-powered fix generation, real-time CVE matching, and GitHub OAuth integration. Runs locally with zero database dependencies.

### PraharShield
**Category:** Security Engineering
**Language:** Java
**URL:** https://github.com/instax-dutta/PraharShield

High-performance bot filtering plugin for Minecraft Velocity proxies. Built on LimboAPI with CAPTCHA handshakes, client fingerprinting, and pattern-based detection to block join-flood attacks on a 1GB RAM VPS.

### DadGuard
**Category:** Windows Security
**Language:** C#
**URL:** https://github.com/instax-dutta/DadGuard

Lightweight Windows security watchdog for protecting non-technical family members. Real-time threat monitoring, suspicious process detection, and alerts with minimal system overhead.

### Binify
**Category:** Privacy Infrastructure
**Language:** TypeScript / Next.js
**URL:** https://bin.sdad.pro
**Repository:** https://github.com/instax-dutta/binify

Zero-knowledge encrypted pastebin with client-side Web Crypto API encryption. Data is encrypted in the browser before transmission, so the server never sees plaintext. Built with Next.js, Turso, and Upstash Redis for rate limiting.

### Ansora
**Category:** Developer Platform
**Language:** TypeScript
**URL:** https://blog.sdad.pro
**Repository:** https://github.com/instax-dutta/ansora

Self-hostable, serverless-deployable blogging platform. Every post is a Markdown file and every save is a git commit. No database and no SaaS CMS. Deploys to Netlify, Vercel, Docker, or any VPS.

### PacketBuddy
**Category:** Network Monitoring
**Language:** Python / JavaScript
**URL:** https://github.com/instax-dutta/packet-buddy

Cross-platform network usage monitor with real-time analytics. Runs quietly in the background, tracks bandwidth usage across interfaces, and provides dashboards with minimal configuration.

### winnow
**Category:** Self-Hosted Product
**Language:** Java
**URL:** https://github.com/instax-dutta/winnow

Self-hosted lead generation and cold-email platform for agencies. Finds published business emails, keeps prospect data local, and sends campaigns through owned mailboxes. Includes tenant isolation, SSRF redirect protection, secret-store isolation, 218 tests, 14 release gates, an SBOM, and checksummed release artifacts.

### truemotion
**Category:** Agent Infrastructure
**Language:** JavaScript
**URL:** https://github.com/instax-dutta/truemotion

MCP motion-graphics studio for coding agents. Agents author HTML/GSAP scenes, inspect rendered frames, receive measured feedback, and export frame-accurate MP4s. Ships 11 MCP tools, deterministic seek-safe timelines, resumable rendering, and 103 tests plus golden-frame, crash, audio, CSP, schema, and concurrency suites.

### gmail-automator
**Category:** Agent Infrastructure
**Language:** Python
**URL:** https://github.com/instax-dutta/gmail-automator

Self-hosted quota-safe Gmail MCP server with encrypted OAuth custody, durable queues, rolling 24-hour quota accounting, paced sending, and an 85% quota ceiling. Ships 14 tools, 61 test files, CI, and release workflows.

## AI Agent Skills

### Brand Vibes
**URL:** https://github.com/instax-dutta/brand-vibes

Ships 66 full brand design profiles plus an off-library DNA-extraction workflow. Applies a company's design language to Tailwind, CSS, or shadcn while vibecoding.

### Market Validator
**URL:** https://github.com/instax-dutta/market-validator

Validates SaaS and product ideas using real user complaints from Reddit, X, G2, Quora, Hacker News, Product Hunt, V2EX, XiaoHongShu, Bilibili, and YouTube through agent-reach.

### Google Code Review
**URL:** https://github.com/instax-dutta/google-code-review

Packages Google's public code-review best practices as an agent skill, covering reviewer and developer perspectives, CL descriptions, feedback, and conflict resolution.

### Only Skills You Need
**URL:** https://github.com/instax-dutta/only-skills-you-need

One install command for a curated coding-skills stack across OpenCode, Claude Code, Antigravity, and Kilocode.

### Roadmap Tutor
**URL:** https://github.com/instax-dutta/roadmap-tutor

Learn any roadmap.sh roadmap one topic at a time, with progress tracked across sessions. Stdlib-only Python that runs on a Raspberry Pi.

### finetune-llm
**URL:** https://github.com/instax-dutta/finetune-llm

Hardware-aware, verification-gated fine-tuning workflow for coding agents. Probes VRAM, chooses an engine, prepares deterministic data, smoke-tests, trains with instrumentation, and verifies with a neutral evaluator. Backed by a controlled four-arm 2x T4 benchmark.

### darpa-audit
**URL:** https://github.com/instax-dutta/darpa-audit

Deterministic startup and project audit based on the Heilmeier Catechism. Runs five ordered prompts, stops at the first failed gate, and returns an explicit SURVIVES / DOES NOT SURVIVE verdict.

### flash-compare
**URL:** https://github.com/instax-dutta/flash-compare

Evidence-first product comparison using OEM specifications, owner reports, independent load tests, verified buyer reviews, and multiple stores. Rejects seeded reviews and inflated listings, then keeps at most two candidates.

## Maelis Research

Maelis Research builds language AI infrastructure for Odia and low-resource Indian languages. Founded in 2026, based in Dhenkanal, Odisha.

**The opportunity:** 38 million Odia speakers. Norwegian (5M), Dutch (25M), and Greek (13M) all have robust AI support, while Odia has far fewer dedicated resources.

**What Maelis is building:**
- Odia tokenizer for the Odia AI API (Brahmic scripts)
- Lekhani Odia-exclusive LLM family
- Shruti Odia speech recognition and synthesis
- Anuvada Odia translation with cultural context
- odia-eval-benchmark with 121,947 rows across 7 task families and 34 datasets

Published artifacts carry their own licenses; see each repository or dataset card.

**Website:** https://maelis.in

## Offsage

Offsage is a technical agency delivering business automation, SaaS development, and web engineering for startups and scaling teams. Built in India, deployed globally.

Discipline-first web engineering: Next.js, React Server Components, mobile-first responsive design, conversion-optimized layouts, and measured animation systems.

**Website:** https://offsage.com
